domains.name: Lesen — Reading Comprehension (notices, signs, short personal messages)
Hören — Listening Comprehension (short announcements, everyday dialogues)
Schreiben — Writing (fill in a form, write a short personal note)
Sprechen — Oral Interaction (introduce yourself, ask/answer simple questions)

exam_price_notes: Approx. €80–€100 (~$87–$110 USD) depending on country and exam centre
exam_rules: No electronic devices (phones, tablets, dictionaries) permitted in the exam room. Oral exams conducted face-to-face with a trained examiner. Bring your ID and registration confirmation.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (passport or national identity card) required at all exam centres.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-23: the Goethe-Institut's Goethe-Zertifikat A1 page says 'The Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1 is a German exam for adults. It certifies that candidates have acquired very basic language skills and corresponds to the first level (A1) on the six-level scale of competence laid down in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).' and still routes candidates to sittings - 'TESTING LOCATIONS Select the Goethe-Institut where you would like to take your German exam and find out more about the dates and prices.' - with 'Internationally recognised certificates for study, work or visa purposes' and published practice materials.

prerequisites.description: None; suitable for absolute beginners with basic German knowledge

renewal_options: All Goethe-Zertifikat certificates have lifetime validity — they do not expire.

retake_policy.notes: No official limit on retakes. Candidates may re-sit at the next available exam date after a failed attempt.
